title: MZ Automatic attack similar to MMORPGs

posts.author: variousordinarygamers
posts.body: I'm new to RPG Maker so I am clueless, sorry. I am currently using the Time Progress battle system in my project, and was wondering if there was a plugin that allowed for a skill to happen independent of the cooldown you see on screen. An example of what I want in another video game would be something like WOW/FF14 where you have an auto attack that happens independent of the skills you press.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Just put that japanese parallel common events in battle plugin running, where you count frames, put VS plugin command for your actors to make attack motion (and move to target if you want), wait a bit, pick a random target from $gameTroop.aliveMembers() and then use gainHp(), startDamagePopup() and conditional startCollapseEffect(). Also, end the battle if all enemies are dead. Turn the switch for the parallel common event off at the start of enemy & actor action sequences + start the sequences with return to home base (wait for movement). LOL.
